subject: Re: MAP & Dedicated GPU pool — staggered slabs + close timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@clearpath.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@clearpath.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff and Dedicated sizing proposal

Rishi — thanks for the deep dive last week. Miguel (procurement) and I chatted and we want to capture a concise MAP so we can align procurement and engineering schedules. High level asks:

- We expect a Q4 pilot (low-latency inference for perception models) then ramp into production over Q1.
- Target pool: starting 8 A100-equivalent GPUs for pilot, 32 for full ramp (flex to split across regions).
- Term preference: 12 months minimum, with option to extend to 24 months if we add reserved capacity.

Can you send a MAP that ties milestones to pricing/credits? Miguel will need clear milestone definitions (pilot start, production ramp, SLA acceptance) so procurement can approve the schedule. Also, we have a hard ask on burst behavior — we need predictable short-term burstability for nightly retrain/validation windows.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Director, Edge Systems
ClearPath Robotics

Attachment: requirements_summary.xlsx (stub)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@clearpath.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and Dedicated sizing proposal

Sarah — appreciate the clarity. I put together a draft MAP and pricing approach that ties committed GPU slabs, milestone credits, and a defined burst window. Key points up front:

1) Staged slab commitment: Pilot slab (8 GPUs) for first 90 days, then staged increase to 16 GPUs at milestone M2 (successful SLA acceptance), then full 32 GPUs at M3 (production ramp). Each slab has an associated monthly committed rate and a per-token overage.

2) Pricing cadence: we propose a 6% effective discount for committing to 12 months on the full 32-GPU configuration; if you sign at 24 months we can move to 10% effective discount. For staged commitments we provide milestone credits (one month credit on the new slab when M2 is achieved).

3) Burst policy: automatic burst up to 1.5x committed pool for short windows (max 6 hours/day) subject to availability. For predictable overnight jobs (up to 12 hours/week) we can reserve an auxiliary burst escrow at a pre-negotiated rate (30% of committed hourly rate).

4) Close timeline suggestion: we recommend approval by 2027-09-10 to hit a 2027-10-01 pilot start. Procurement/Legal lead times are reflected in the MAP owner actions.

I attached: ClearPath_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestones, timelines, and slab pricing) and SOW_Dedicated_GPU_pool.pdf (scope). Grace will coordinate the SLA specifics; Tessa is copied for finance crediting mechanics.

Next step: can we get Miguel and Dan's feedback on the burst escrow and the staged-credit mechanics?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0119

From: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@clearpath.ai>

Cc: Dan O'Neil <dan.oneil@clearpath.ai>
Date: 2027-08-25T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and Dedicated sizing proposal

Thanks Rishi — overall this looks reasonable. A few follow-ups from procurement/legal side:

- Burst escrow: procurement would prefer a fixed monthly escrow line-item (predictable $ amount) rather than a variable 30% of hourly rate. Could your team provide an example $ amount based on our expected weekly burst needs (we estimate 8 hours/night x 5 nights, peaking over a 3-week validation window)?
- Milestone credits: need clear, testable acceptance criteria for M2 (SLA acceptance). Describe the SLI thresholds and acceptance tests in the SOW section so our QA can sign off.
- Term flexibility: are there step-down options if we underutilize in month 4–6? We need guardrails to avoid paying for idle capacity while still meeting ramp guarantees.

Dan — can you confirm the legal redline turnaround target? We need to know whether a 10-business-day review is possible.

Regards,
Miguel
Head of Procurement
ClearPath Robotics

From: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@clearpath.ai>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@clearpath.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-27T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and Dedicated sizing proposal

Miguel — thanks for the specifics. Quick answers and proposed edits to the MAP/SOW: 

- Burst escrow (practical example): based on your weekly estimate (~40 hours/week of burst), the escrow would be $7,200 for a 3-week validation window (calculation: estimated hourly auxiliary rate $60 x 40 hours/week x 3 weeks). If you prefer a monthly line-item, we can amortize expected burst usage across initial term — example: $2,400/month for first three months, then true-up after M3.

- SLI-based acceptance criteria (M2): propose 99th percentile latency < 120ms for the configured batch sizes during a 7-day acceptance window, and successful KV-cache persistence across restart tests. We'll add explicit test scripts and pass/fail criteria in the SOW.

- Underutilization guardrail: offer a one-time 25% step-down option at the end of month 3 (applies only if usage < 50% of committed tokens for the prior 30 days), with a small re-provision fee to return to prior slab. This preserves predictability while offering operational flexibility.

Attached: Draft_SLA_redlines.docx (highlights inserted). We're happy to model alternative numbers if Miguel has a target escrow $ he wants us to use.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
